mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 5 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 5, low -5.

Kosovo parliament will hold two plenary sessions on Thursday, starting at 10:00 and again at 13:00, with unfinished items on the agenda and a new draft law on specialized housing to be processed this week.

North Macedonia's Minister of Education Vesna Janevska announced that teachers will receive at least a 7.5% salary increase in March, funded from the current budget, while no new teaching positions will be created.

NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte warned that security risks are rising as Russia continues to strengthen its military industry.

At a concert in New Orleans featuring Usher and Chris Brown, a fire performer fell from the stage stairs, prompting a frightening incident during the show.

European Union ambassador to Kosovo Dirk Schuebel met with members of the parliamentary integration committee, led by LDK deputy Jehona Lushtaku, to discuss close cooperation on Kosovo's EU accession plan.
